STARCAM for Nintendo DS
=======================

HOW TO INSTALL ON AN R4 CARD
1. Unzip this file (on a phone or computer). Do NOT copy the .zip itself:
   the R4 can't open zip files.
2. Put the R4's microSD card in your phone/computer.
3. Copy STARCAM.NDS onto the microSD card, in the same folder as your
   other games (usually the main/root folder).
4. Put the card back in the R4, start the DS, and pick STARCAM from the menu.

The R4 menu patches the game for the card automatically, the same as it
does for other homebrew.

CONTROLS
  D-pad ........ aim the camera
  L / R ........ zoom out / in
  A ............ take a photo
  X / Y ........ next / previous target
  B or SELECT .. guide lines on/off
  START ........ photo album
  Touch screen . everything above, plus the zoom slider

GOAL
Find and photograph all 14 targets: 9 constellations, the Moon, Jupiter,
Saturn, a comet and a shooting star. Each photo gets 1-3 stars depending
on how well it's framed.

Progress saves to starcam.sav and photos to the starcam_photos folder on
the card. Photos are ordinary BMP pictures you can open on a computer.
